notes:
Site: IKEA France (ikea.com/fr/fr). Homepage nav labels a hub link 'Bonnes affaires' -> https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/offers/, whose HTML links to https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/cat/last-chance/ (title text in raw HTML: 'Nos offres outlet'). Opened with Playwright (tier 2, after tier-1 HTTP fetch showed only client-rendered nav JSON). H1 is 'Offres Outlet', page <title> 'Offres outlet : fins de serie et petits prix ! - IKEA', on-page copy: "Decouvrez notre espace outlet avec des offres de destockage sur nos futures fins de serie. Des bons plans pour tous jusqu'a 50% de remises sur une vaste gamme d'articles deco et de meubles, renouveles tous les mois..." plus footer copy 'Des produits prix outlet toute l'annee ... tous nos produits amenes a disparaitre sont listes sur cette page ... avant qu'ils ne disparaissent de nos stocks'. This is the site's own outlet/end-of-line concept (deliberately discontinued 'fins de serie' / 'produits amenes a disparaitre' - products leaving the range, sold while stock lasts), not a temporary seasonal campaign, so it clears the Clearance-vs-Sale test in Sec.3 (note: France does NOT use the regulated legal term 'Soldes' anywhere on this page or the offers hub - confirmed via full-text search of the raw HTML, zero matches - IKEA FR instead uses 'Outlet'/'destockage'/'fins de serie', which are the genuine permanent-markdown signal words for this locale). Individual product tiles carry two sub-badges within the SAME listing - 'Outlet' (discontinued line, reduced) and 'Collection limitee' (limited-run item, reduced) - both merchandised together under the one /cat/last-chance/ URL with no separate URL per badge type, so kept as a single row (matches the UK sibling's 'Last chance'+'Clearance' dual-badge pattern on one URL). Page text shows '86 elements' twice (page header + filter-panel header) and the results-list footer independently confirms 'Affiche 24 resultats sur 86' - qty verified reliable. SEPARATELY CHECKED AND EXCLUDED: (1) https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/cat/lower-price/ ('Prix baisse' / 'Nos produits a prix baisse - Petits prix', 423 items) - copy reads 'Nous baissons nos prix sur plus de 300 produits ! Chez IKEA, le prix a baisse, pas la qualite' - this is a general everyday-low-price value campaign spanning ordinary in-range stock (its own filter panel shows 'Top ventes' 13 and 'Nouveaux produits' 14 sub-facets, i.e. it overlaps ordinary bestseller/new-arrival stock, not discontinued/outlet stock), with no permanence/leaving-the-range signal - excluded per the generic-Sale rule, not flagged ambiguous since the distinction from Outlet is clear (no 'end of line' language, explicitly ongoing/ordinary-range pricing). (2) https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/offers/family-offers/ ('Offres speciales programme de fidelite IKEA Family') - loyalty-member promotional offers, excluded. (3) https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/offers/limited-time-offers/ ('Offres a duree limitee') - literally time-limited promotional page, excluded. No other clearance/outlet-labelled entry point found in nav, footer, offers hub, or raw-HTML term search ('solde', 'destockage', 'derniere chance', 'clearance', 'fin de serie'). No Claude-specific disallow in robots.txt; did not need Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3).
